calm, steady news narration with natural emphasis at key points and turns; not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: But this test missed one important notice. The vice president of Meta’s Superintelligence Labs division wrote a post for Meta staff. There, the vice president called it a mistake. The mistake was starting a test where contract workers made calls without clearly telling people. The vice president also said Meta had paused its Human Concierge feature for now. Let’s check the breaking news caption once more. What Meta pulled back was the Human Concierge feature. It did not stop all calls through MUSE. Canceling a whole show and pausing one part are different things. So, is it wrong by itself to bring in a human helper? Sometimes passing the conversation to a person can help it move forward, but saying, "a person will take over from here" is very different. Quietly changing the cast behind the scenes is not the same. In a movie, you might clap when a mysterious person is revealed. You might say, ah, so that’s who it is. But you may not want that surprise in a conversation you are part of.
